Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and attachments. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we require the most recent Type II report; an NDA is fine. Ideally we'll get the report and the associated bridge letters for the last 12 months.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Amaya will be handling EU customers and some regulated healthcare pilot customers. Can you confirm whether HIPAA support (and a BAA) is available for Hosted or only for Dedicated/Private deployments?
- Retention needs:
  * Deletion SLA: For user deletion requests we need an auditable confirmation that data is no longer accessible within 30 days and removed from backups within 180 days (or a contractually agreed shorter window).
  * Backup retention: by default, we prefer 180 days for backups; for long-term regulated archives we may need up to 7 years depending on the dataset — is that supported as an add-on?
  * Logs: we need at least 180 days of request/trace logs for the pilot.

Finally, we'll need to kick off the vendor questionnaire flow — if you can send a secure link to the pre-filled questionnaire (or a DocuSign flow), Sophie and I will route to our security team.

If you can confirm which items are standard vs. contract-only, that will help speed internal approvals. Happy to do the sync on Tue Apr 27 at 10 AM PT if that works.

Hi Liam / Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Answers below (summary first, details after):

Summary answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II program; we can provide the latest report and bridge letters under a mutual NDA.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA (BAA) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted (shared) plans we offer controls aligned to HIPAA but we require Dedicated/Private and a signed BAA for full HIPAA coverage.
- GDPR: We provide GDPR-compliant controls, data processing agreements (DPA), and EU region hosting options.
- Deletion & backups:
  * Logical deletion from active stores: up to 30 days (configurable via contract).
  * Backups: default retention 180 days; we can negotiate shorter retention for scoped data or longer retention (multi-year) as a contractual add-on.
  * Deletion from backups: standard process is best-effort immediate remove + reapplied retention lifecycle — we commit to removing scoped data from backups within 180 days by default; shorter windows can be discussed in contract.
- Logs: default request/trace log retention is 90 days; we can extend to 180 days or longer via contract and pricing. Audit logs for deletion requests are available and we can provide exportable reports as proof of deletion.

More details: 
1) SOC 2 report access
   - Process: we'll send an NDA template; once executed we can share the full SOC 2 Type II report and supporting bridge letters. If you prefer, we can also provide a redacted lite pack for initial review.

2) GDPR / DPA
   - We provide a standard DPA. For EU hosting we can pin accounts to EU regions and ensure data residency for inference artifacts and logs.

3) HIPAA / BAA
   - We require Dedicated or Private deployment for HIPAA covered workloads and will execute a BAA. We can discuss scope (e.g., whether audit logs or backups are included) during contracting.

4) Retention & deletion specifics
   - Logical deletion: when Amaya or an end-customer requests user data deletion, we mark the data as deleted within 30 days and remove from primary indexes/storage.
   - Backup retention & deletion: backups are on a retention lifecycle; removal of individual records from historical backups is performed via our backup lifecycle process — default maximum is 180 days. For regulated data requiring longer retention, we support contractually managed archives (7+ years) as an add-on with appropriate encryption/segmentation.
   - Proof of deletion / audit: We maintain immutable audit logs for deletion requests and can provide a signed confirmation (timestamped) tied to the deletion job. We can also provide exportable reports for compliance reviews.

5) Logs retention
   - Default: 90 days.
   - Options: 180 days / custom retention available for purchase. We can also stream logs to your SIEM (S3/CloudWatch/LogHub) if you prefer to maintain them on your side.

6) Questionnaire
   - We'll start the vendor questionnaire flow now.
